subject: physics

hotspots.label: Glass Globe
hotspots.description: The transparent shell that lets the filament's light shine out.
hotspots.colorHint: Clear crystal-like sphere over the filament.

hotspots.label: Filament
hotspots.description: The coiled thin wire that turns current into white heat and light.

hotspots.label: Support Wires
hotspots.description: The slim posts that hold the filament in place.
hotspots.colorHint: Two fine pale wires from base to coil.
hotspots.function: Anchor the filament inside the globe.

hotspots.label: Screw Base
hotspots.description: The metal ring and tip that complete the circuit contact.
hotspots.colorHint: Brass-ridged cap at the bulb's bottom.
hotspots.function: Closes the current path through the bulb.

hotspots.label: Switch
hotspots.description: The lever that opens or closes the loop and with it the glow.
hotspots.colorHint: Small amber rocker on the wire run.
hotspots.function: Decides whether current reaches the filament.

hotspots.label: Current Path
hotspots.description: The highlighted route current takes: battery to base, through the filament, and back.
hotspots.colorHint: A softly glowing blue trace over the wires.
hotspots.function: Shows the complete loop at a glance.

visualStyleNotes: Warm off-white paper ground, soft vignette. A cross-section clear bulb standing on a small base, switch and battery beside it, filament at center.
materialNotes: Globe: roughness ~0.1, metallic 0 (clear). Filament: rough tiny coil, no bloom but glow intensity tied to current. Base brass rough metallic ~0.5.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: anatomy of the filament bulb and the closed-loop requirement.

GEOMETRY: a glass globe (r≈0.5, y≈1.6) with a coiled filament at (0,1.0,0), support wires, screw base (0,0.4,0); a switch and battery off to the right; a traceable current path.

INTERACTION: the switch closes/opens the loop; filament goes grey→white with ammeter; a path highlight draws the full loop.

NAMED NODES: Globe, Filament, SupportL, SupportR, Base, Switch, PathGlow. 7-10k tris.
